newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Poh Lian initial public offer 33 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Poh Lian initial public offer 33 times subscribed.

text.p: Poh Lian Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday the 40.5 million share tranche made available to the public in its initial public offering was 33 times subscribed.
The shares will begin trading on the SES at 0100 GMT on Thursday on a when issued basis.

The company said in a statement that in addition to the 40.5 million shares made available to the public, 5.4 million were taken up by management and employees and 8.1 million had been placed directly with investors.

"We are pleased with the response and would like to thank all investors for their support. The proceeds will support our efforts to realise our expansion plans," Poh Lian chief executive Tan Eng Khiam was quoted as saying in the statement.
The construction group said it would use the funds raised by the offer to invest in two regional joint ventures, to expand its access equipment range and to invest in new machinery.
The surplus would be used to repay bank borrowings and increase working capital, it said.
